name: Paul Henry
photo_credit: Supplied to policy.nz by the candidate/party

questionnaire_2026.Why I'm standing: New Zealand should be one of the most prosperous countries on Earth, but we're not meeting our potential. My wife and I have ten grandchildren between us, and I want them to inherit a country that rewards hard work, values freedom, and gives people the opportunity to build better lives. I'm running because I'm not prepared to sit back while New Zealand becomes poorer, less ambitious, and weighed down by ever-bigger government. Party vote ACT.
questionnaire_2026.About me: I've spent decades asking difficult questions, challenging people in power, and saying what I think. I'll bring energy and common-sense to Parliament. I'm standing list-only. The best way to elect me and more of ACT's strong team is to party vote ACT. It'll keep the coalition Government in power, but going further and faster on the issues that matter most. This election is crucial, a lurch to the left would devastate our economy for generations.

status_detail: Broadcaster standing for ACT at #4 on the party list in 2026 (list only per Wikipedia's list page). Resigned from the TVNZ board in July 2026 after announcing his candidacy.
roles: Broadcaster (TVNZ Breakfast 2004–2010; The Paul Henry Show; Paul Henry on TV3/Radio Live 2015–2016; host of The Traitors NZ and The Chase NZ)
